headline: Ekko, Xayah and Kog'Maw lead patch 26.22. More than half of the most-picked champions lose.
lede: Built on nine stat sites from Korea, Europe and North America. Of the 65 champions picked in 5% or more of their role's games, 36 win less than half. Scores are win rate points above the role average, corrected for sample size and one-trick inflation.

takes.top: Singed, Kayle and Malphite are the safe picks, and in Diamond and up Fiora, Shen and Darius join them. Jayce and Yone are picked a lot and still lose, and Yasuo dropped more than anyone since last patch.
takes.jungle: Zyra, Lillia and Nunu lead, and in high elo Zyra and Nunu are clear outliers with Rek'Sai close behind. Lee Sin is in 13% of games and loses, and Qiyana is the worst popular pick in the role.
takes.mid: Ekko is the outlier at every rank, with Vex, Katarina and Vladimir behind him. Mel and Viktor gained the most since last patch, but Viktor is still a trap at 7.7% pick.
takes.adc: Kog'Maw and Xayah are ahead of everyone, and Corki gained more than any champion since last patch. Ezreal is in 15% of games and has the worst score of any popular ADC.
takes.support: Ten supports are S, so pick what fits your bot laner: Rell and Zilean score highest, and Rell is the outlier in high elo. Yuumi, Karma and Lux are popular and lose, and Thresh dropped the most since last patch.
